subtitle: Seattle seen through a neon trail

body: inFAMOUS First Light is Sucker Punch Productions' PlayStation 4 action-adventure, released in North America on 26 August 2014. Abigail Walker, known as Fetch, recounts the events that brought her into custody at Curdun Cay. Her story precedes Second Son and gives one of its supporting characters an adventure of her own. Neon powers carry her across a fictional Seattle and shape the way she fights. The standalone release does not require Second Son, making its shorter campaign an independent way to enter this part of the setting.

Fetch can move at speed using her neon abilities, turning travel across streets and buildings into a flowing route toward the next objective. The same power supplies attacks whose precision and timing become important against groups of enemies. Sources of neon in the city connect movement and combat to the surroundings, giving the familiar urban map a different practical meaning from another character's route through it. Completing activities develops those abilities, making Fetch progressively more effective at linking an approach, a shot and an escape through the same space.

The campaign alternates Fetch's memories with her imprisonment, while challenge arenas concentrate on fighting successive threats and improving a score. Those arenas give the powers room to be used without another story mission determining the pace. Nate Fox directed the project, supported by music from Marc Canham, Nathan Johnson and Brain. Critics generally welcomed Fetch's abilities and the presentation, with more mixed responses to the story's scale and combat. Its focused set of powers makes it a character study expressed through movement as well as the events Fetch describes.
